review: The saved-only query reads all bookmarks without filtering userId. Switching members therefore reveals threads saved by someone else, although the per-thread saved indicator is scoped correctly.
The route trusts authorId from the request body instead of the stored comment.authorId. Another member can send their own authorId and edit someone else’s comment.
preview repeats the normalization, Unicode and truncation logic in excerpt in src/text.ts. Please delegate to that helper so fixes to truncation do not diverge between post and comment summaries.

Bounds checks accept NaN and fractional offset/limit values. Number conversion from URL parameters can yield NaN, and slice silently coerces these inputs, so invalid pagination requests slip through. Require Number.isInteger for both inputs.

Post text goes straight into innerHTML after regex replacements, without escaping existing markup. A saved post with an img onerror attribute will execute JavaScript when another member opens the feed.

The query is used directly as a RegExp even though the issue requests literal search. Searching [ throws and punctuation changes matching; complex patterns can cause excessive CPU. Treat input as plain text.

The VotingPipeline registry adds layers for a single fixed upvote. Nothing in this release needs extension steps; future maintainers must navigate extra machinery to change one write. Use a direct function.
There is no posts.authorId filter in the notification query, so members see comments on everyone’s threads. Restrict it to threads owned by the current member and exclude their own comments.
